chapters.text: This is the final R seven magnetic pressure head.
The exploded view separates the enclosure, moving carriage, metal springs, magnet, and fixed Hall sensor.
Join the adaptor and chassis. Secure the magnet and retainer to the carriage, then lower the carriage into place.
The temporary bridge and service pin hold the carriage while both metal leaves are clamped. Then install the sensor.
Remove the bridge and fit the cover. Insert the cartridge, turn it thirty degrees, and tighten its small lock. Remove the entire red service pin before measuring.
Pressing the filament moves the blue carriage and bends both metal leaves. The magnet moves with the carriage. Releasing lets the springs return.
Here, the surrounding parts are hidden. Watch the coral magnet approach the stationary purple Hall sensor. The changing magnetic signal must be calibrated against known forces.
Print and calibrate next. Accuracy at one, ten, and seventy five grams force remains unverified.
